headline: Community groups rally to keep PEI children warm this winter
meta_description: Groups on Prince Edward Island are stepping up to ensure local children have the winter clothing they need as temperatures drop.
summary_short: As winter approaches, community organizations on Prince Edward Island are working together to make sure children stay warm through the cold months ahead.
body:
Community groups on Prince Edward Island are mobilizing to ensure children across the island have warm clothing as winter sets in.

With temperatures dropping and families reaching for winter clothes, local organizations have recognized that not all households have equal access to adequate outerwear and gear. These groups are taking action to close that gap, working to support young people through the season ahead.

The collaborative effort reflects a broader commitment within Prince Edward Island communities to look out for vulnerable families. By pooling resources and coordinating their efforts, these organizations aim to make sure that no child on the island faces the winter without proper protection from the cold.
quick_facts: Multiple groups working together on Prince Edward Island
Supporting children with winter clothing access
